1.t: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning
1.tr: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa

2.t: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see
2.tr: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta-leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa

3.t: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful
3.tr: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw Wa-immaa kafoora

4.t: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire
4.tr: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa-fireena salaasila Wa-aghlaalanw Wa-sa'eeraa

5.t: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—
5.tr: Innal abraara yashra-boona min kaasin kaana mizaa-juhaa kaafooraa

6.t: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will
6.tr: Aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yufajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa

7.t: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror
7.tr: Yoofoona binnazri Wa-yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa

8.t: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive
8.tr: Wa-yut'imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw Wa-yateemanw Wa-aseeraa

9.t: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you
9.tr: Innaamaa nut'imukum li-wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw Wa-laa shukooraa

10.t: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
10.tr: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa

11.t: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy
11.tr: Fa-waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi Wa-laqqaahum nadratanw Wa-surooraa

12.t: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk

13.t: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold
13.tr: Muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa-'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw Wa-laa zamhareeraa

14.t: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach

15.t: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—
15.tr: Wa-yutaafu 'alaihim bi-aaniyatim min fiddatinw Wa-akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa

16.t: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired

17.t: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger
17.tr: Wa-yuskawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa

18.t: from a spring there, called Salsabîl

19.t: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls
19.tr: Wa-yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra-aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu-'am mansoora

20.t: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom
20.tr: Wa-izaa ra-ayta samma ra-ayta na'eemanw Wa-mulkan kabeera

21.t: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink
21.tr: Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw Wa-istabraq, Wa-hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw Wa-saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa

22.t: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”
22.tr: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz-'anw Wa-kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa

23.t: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages

24.t: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them
24.tr: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika Wa-laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa

25.t: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening

26.t: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night
26.tr: Wa-minal laili fasjud lahoo Wa-sabbihhu lailan taweelaa

27.t: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them
27.tr: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata Wa-yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa

28.t: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others
28.tr: Nahnu khalaqnaahum Wa-shadadnaaa asrahum Wa-izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala-hum tabdeelaa

29.t: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
29.tr: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa-man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela

30.t: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
30.tr: Wa-maa tashaaa'oona illaa any yashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana 'Aleeman Hakeema

31.t: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
31.tr: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa
